hero.title: From Strategy to Revenue. One Platform.
hero.description: Define your brand voice and positioning once. Every campaign, creative, and opportunity anchors to your strategy automatically. Track attribution from first click to closed deal.

body: Define your brand voice, positioning, target ICPs, and proof points once — every campaign, creative asset, and opportunity automatically anchors to your strategy profile. The system continuously analyzes your market, competitors, and performance data to surface opportunities you'd miss: pricing gaps, trend shifts, and reuse angles. Anonymous visitor sessions are tracked from first click through conversion, so you can see which creative, campaign, and channel drove every lead, booking, and order.

dashboard.caption: 9 dashboards in one: strategy, campaigns, broadcasts, funnels, proof assets, creative, calendar, and ROI analytics.

benefits.title: AI opportunity discovery
benefits.desc: The system analyzes your market, competitors, and performance data to surface opportunities — trend shifts, competitor gaps, and reuse angles you'd otherwise miss.

benefits.title: Multi-touch attribution
benefits.desc: Anonymous visitor sessions tracked from first click through conversion. See which creative, campaign, and channel drove every lead, booking, and order.

benefits.title: Offer orchestration
benefits.desc: Link products to campaigns with dynamic pricing — percent off, fixed price, bundles. Control where and when offers appear across all your marketing surfaces.

scenario: Your competitor just raised prices on emergency plumbing. HABOS surfaces an AI opportunity: "Emergency service pricing gap — competitors average $195/call, you're at $150. Recommend: increase to $175 and run a '24/7 Emergency' campaign." You click "Create Campaign" — it's pre-populated with the opportunity data, linked to your emergency service product, and ready to publish.

cta.heading: Other marketing tools track campaigns. HABOS connects campaigns to revenue.
